{{Top|leg}}
A '''unisuit''' was regulation uniform worn by workers of various types.

A [[Color/Legends|gray-blue]] unisuit, for example, was worn by [[Miner/Legends|miners]] of the [[Home Planet Mine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]]; even high-ranking company officials such as [[VeerTa]] wore the unisuit.

On the booming industry planet of [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]], a red unisuit was worn by workers at the [[Blackwater Systems]] [[Blackwater Systems facility|facility]] on the outskirts of the [[Capital/Legends|capital city]] of [[Falleen Throne]]. In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], undercover [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] wore unisuits at the factory while investigating its possible ties to arch-enemy of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], [[Force void/Legends|Force Blank]] [[Granta Omega]].
